objective: Test entry selection, position age, stop loss, take profit and cooldown as executable position lifecycle rules at fixed target gross 2.7
entry: Daily decisions at UTC 01:00 using previous completed daily candle; same delay for baseline. Confirm2 requires same target direction on two completed daily signals. age90_no_shock3sigma requires 90 calendar days since first observed candle and no abs daily return >3 preceding-day vol20 during preceding 3 completed days, filtering universe before ranking.
exit: Stops/TP inspect just-completed hourly OHLC and execute at next hourly open plus explicit trading friction, never at ideal barrier. Trail uses peak from prior completed hours; update peak only after trigger check, avoiding unknown intrabar high/low order. Hourly monitoring is the tested product, not exchange resting-stop behavior.
position_state: First entry starts age; additions update weighted entry without resetting age; reductions preserve entry; flips reset age. Any risk exit blocks that coin in both directions for at least24h. Daily rebalance cannot immediately reopen blocked positions. Sigma stop at entry max(0.02,2*prior20day volatility).
coverage: Hourly cached July-Oct2026 plus fresh recent data, >=60 completed days desired; incomplete held price disqualifies run. Daily long-history cannot validate intraday exits. Funding and liquidation model remain incomplete.
validation: First half vs second half, last observed nine days diagnostic only; block bootstrap all9 variants; no true unseen OOS and no deployment based on single recent winner
